items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: That's when we used to have Buddy Bowling playing... So that's where I know both of those from.

ctx.x: That's when we used to have Buddy Bowling playing what's called Johnson Park and Robichaud playing and Lincoln Park. There was about four blocks separating each other, you see. So that's where I know both of those from. I used to visit those places, but I would live in Indiana. I was a boy.
Can you remember any other members of that Bowling band at that time?
